maddeler.e:
نعترف (form VIII)
# نَعْتَرِفُ (naʕtarifu) /naʕ.ta.ri.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# نُعْتَرَفُ (nuʕtarafu) /nuʕ.ta.ra.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# نَعْتَرِفَ (naʕtarifa) /naʕ.ta.ri.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# نُعْتَرَفَ (nuʕtarafa) /nuʕ.ta.ra.fa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
